The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Voontara Fa'athra]] lived in a '''palace''' in the [[Eastern Grime]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The palace contained many of the usual amenities of Hutt residences: a throne room, guest rooms, and a beast pit; however, it was not suited to entertaining visitors like [[Nem'ro's Palace]], having no [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and being off-limits to all but [[Fa'athra gang|Fa'athra's men]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the palace was heavily protected by Fa'athra's forces, but was infiltrated by several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], including the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], who killed his rival [[Rarsk]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Albea]] deep in the structure's interior.

[[Cipher Nine|An agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] also infiltrated the palace, acquiring a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] with which to falsify evidence that the Republic was involved in the assassination of [[Karrels Javis]], a lieutenant of [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. With this holodisc, the agent convinced Nem'ro to side with the Empire.
